enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Breathe deeply. Move arm. Turn again. Shift position. Pull blanket down. Turn to back. Breathe steadily.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take bowl from cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Take spoon from drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Put bowl and spoon in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Check phone again. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to locker room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Put on uniform. Wash hands. Check patient list. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update chart. Walk to nurse station. Discuss with colleague. Answer phone. Attend meeting. Take notes.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk with colleague. Check phone. Clear tray. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient list. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Take blood pressure. Draw blood. Label sample. Walk to lab. Deliver sample. Return to nurse station. Update records. Answer call. Consult with doctor. Prepare equipment.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel again. Put down remote. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Continue watching TV.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Type password. Open browser. Check email. Reply to email. Open document. Type report. Save document. Open social media. Scroll through feed. Watch video. Close laptop.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.
Sit on bed. Pick up book. Read book. Put down book. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Breathe steadily.
